pictures.name: dawn_over_the_hill_country
pictures.scene: a wide country of low rounded hills taking the first clean light of dawn, the near slope lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the ridges and the sky above them pale and open and still

pictures.name: larks_rising_over_a_field
pictures.scene: two small brown larks lifting steeply off an open field into the morning air, the stubble below them lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the wide sky above the birds pale and clear and empty

pictures.name: blossom_open_in_warm_light
pictures.scene: a branch of white blossom fully open in soft warm light, the nearest flowers lit bright and gold low in the frame, the leaves and the air above them going quiet and green and softly out of focus

pictures.name: new_wall_rising_course_by_course
pictures.scene: a new city wall of dressed stone rising course upon level course, the lowest blocks lit warm and hard along the bottom of the frame, the unfinished top and the sky above it pale and plain and open

pictures.name: many_tracks_converging_on_a_gate
pictures.scene: several worn footpaths across open country all bending in to meet at one open gate, the nearest track lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the land and gateway beyond them soft and dim

pictures.name: healed_bark_over_an_old_wound
pictures.scene: the trunk of an old tree where a deep cut has grown smoothly over with new bark, the healed scar lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the trunk above it rising dark and quiet and whole

pictures.name: star_field_over_a_still_lake
pictures.scene: countless stars standing over a lake so still that it holds them all again, the near shore lit faintly warm at the bottom of the frame, the sky above it deep and black and thick with light

pictures.name: endless_mountain_ranges
pictures.scene: range behind range of mountains fading away one past another with no end to them, the nearest ridge lit warm and hard low in the frame, the far peaks above going pale and blue and immeasurable

pictures.name: low_growing_herb_in_full_flower
pictures.scene: a low creeping herb hugging the bare ground and covered in small open flowers, the nearest blooms lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the dry ground beyond them dim and flat and plain

pictures.name: harvest_offering_heaped_on_a_stone
pictures.scene: first fruits and sheaves of grain heaped up together on a broad flat stone, the nearest offering lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the open court above and behind it quiet and dim

pictures.name: harp_strings_in_warm_light
pictures.scene: the strings and curved frame of a wooden harp standing in low warm light, the sounding board lit gold at the bottom of the frame, the strings and the air above them going soft and dark and calm

pictures.name: wide_cloud_cover_over_the_land
pictures.scene: an unbroken ceiling of heavy grey cloud drawn right across a wide country, the near fields lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the great cloud above them even and dim and unhurried

pictures.name: first_rain_on_dry_dust
pictures.scene: the first drops of rain striking dry pale dust and darkening it in small rings, the wet ground lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the dusty air above it soft and grey and thickening

pictures.name: raven_chicks_in_a_cliff_nest
pictures.scene: a rough nest of sticks on a cliff ledge with two dark young ravens calling from it, the ledge lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the rock wall above them rising sheer and dim and vast

pictures.name: strong_horse_standing_in_a_field
pictures.scene: a powerful horse standing quietly alone in an open field, its chest and legs lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the pasture and sky above and behind it wide and pale and untroubled

pictures.name: evening_pasture_full_of_light
pictures.scene: a broad green pasture flooded with long warm evening light, the near grass and a small stream lit gold along the bottom of the frame, the hills and sky above them soft and blue and altogether calm

lines.text: Hallelujah!
How good it is to sing praises to our God,
how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
The LORD builds up Jerusalem;
He gathers the exiles of Israel.
He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their wounds.
He determines the number of the stars;
He calls them each by name.
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;
His understanding has no limit.
The LORD sustains the humble,
but casts the wicked to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving;
make music on the harp to our God,
who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass to grow on the hills.
He provides food for the animals,
and for the young ravens when they call.
He does not delight in the strength of the horse;
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him,
who hope in His loving devotion.
